subject: Religious Studies
text: Explain two ways the incarnation affects Christian beliefs about Jesus.
answer: Jesus is fully human and understands human suffering. Jesus is also God the Son, meaning his teachings reveal God's nature.
model: The incarnation means God became human in Jesus. First, Christians believe Jesus is fully human, so he understands human suffering and temptation. Second, he is also God the Son, so his life and teachings show Christians what God is like.
explain: Include two developed points linking incarnation to beliefs about Jesus.

subject: Religious Studies
text: Give two reasons why the resurrection is important to Christians.
answer: It demonstrates Jesus' victory over death. It gives Christians hope of eternal life.
explain: Resurrection proves Jesus' power over death and gives hope of life after death.

subject: Religious Studies
text: Explain two ways the Trinity is shown in Christian worship.
answer: Christians may pray to the Father through the Son and in the Holy Spirit. Baptism uses the names of the Father, Son and Holy Spirit.
model: In worship, Christians express belief in one God as Father, Son and Holy Spirit. For example, prayers are often addressed to the Father through Jesus the Son in the power of the Holy Spirit, and baptism is performed in the name of the Father, Son and Holy Spirit.
explain: Give two worship practices/prayers and explain how each reflects the Trinity.

subject: Religious Studies
answer: Jesus returning to heaven after the resurrection|return to heaven
explain: The ascension is Jesus returning to heaven forty days after his resurrection.
